newsitem.title: USA: PLC Systems to submit heart laser data.
newsitem.headline: PLC Systems to submit heart laser data.

text.p: PLC Systems Inc said on Wednesday the Food and Drug Administration panel's decision not to recommend approval of PLC's heart laser is a "temporary setback" and that the company will submit data to the agency as soon as possible.

"The Company had expected to ship approximately 50 Heart Laser Systems in 1997," chairman Dr. Robert Rudko said in a statement. "The recent FDA decision will impact Heart Laser shipments and will likely delay a number of shipments into future quarters."
The shipments were contingent upon FDA approval, the company said.

The company said a recent $20 million financing commitment completed through Smith Barney, of which $10 million has been received by the Company, should assist in the company's pursuit of clinicians accepting use of the laser.
The heart laser intends to treat patient with chronic chest pain who do not respond to angioplasty or coronary artery bypass surgery.
